title: Create with Rovo: Generate content for new whiteboards and databases
description:
Save time when starting new projects by using Rovo to generate content for whiteboards and databases. When you create a new whiteboard or database in Confluence, Rovo provides an inline prompt or modal to help you quickly populate your work with relevant ideas and structures. Create a new whiteboard or database in Confluence.
	You will see a Create with Rovo prompt box, which appears as a popup or side modal on whiteboards, or at the bottom of the screen on databases.
	Enter a prompt to describe
